title: Defense Devil
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kucabara, a demon prince banished and stripped of his powers, becomes a 'Defense Devil': a lawyer who proves the innocence of souls condemned to hell so he can collect their dark matter, though his soft heart keeps him spending it to save them. With the dragon demon Bichula and the exorcist nun Idamaria he returns to the demon world to stop his brother Legato, uncovers angels who rule hell, and ends recruited to defend God against angels who have betrayed Him. Ten volumes, written and drawn by Korean creators for a Japanese magazine.
life_message: Mercy toward the condemned and loyalty to friends matter more than reclaiming power.
